title: Awesome Scavenger Hunt: Houston's Museum District
includes: Digital Copies of your adventure hunt photos
Photo challenges for each player - choose between Braniac, Photographer, Mapper
Let's Roam App access for maps, photo challenges, riddles and leaderboards
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: Weather Check: Check the weather forecast for the day of your hunt and dress appropriately. Comfortable shoes and weather appropriate attire are recommended
Please note that this is a self-guided private tour so you can start at any time and at your own pace
Fully Charged Devices: Make sure your smartphone is fully charged before the tour as you’ll be using it to navigate and interact with the app. Please bring a power bank if you need it.
Booking Confirmation: Confirmation will be received at time of booking along with instructions on downloading the app and starting your adventure
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Get ready to take your day from ordinary to extraordinary with Let’s Roam—the ultimate app-led scavenger hunt adventure! Picture this: exploring the coolest landmarks and uncovering hidden gems while tackling trivia questions and solving challenges with your crew.

Whether you’re out with friends, celebrating a bachelorette party, or boosting team morale at a corporate event, Let’s Roam turns every occasion into an unforgettable adventure. Each player gets to dive into interactive roles, making every challenge uniquely exciting and engaging.

So, lace up those shoes, download the app, and get ready to create memories that will last a lifetime. Let’s Roam scavenger hunts aren’t just an activity—they’re a passport to fun, laughter, and discovering the magic in every city. Let the games begin!
